title: 15.45. Cittānuparivattiduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Cittānuparivattiṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā nava …pe… avigate nava.
Cittānuparivattiṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā nava …pe… avigate nava. (Abyākatamūlaṁ tīṇiyeva paccayavasena.)
